sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Grafton Selectboard members: Cathy Goodwin-Siano (Chair), Anna Keegan (Vice Chair), John Gregory, Warren Fisher, and Peter Richardson. The factory prints the chair's surname as 'Siano-Goodwin'; the directory's order governs.

Town of Grafton 2024 Town Report, OFFICERS table as of June 30, 2024 (graftonvt.org): Kim Record holds the clerkship on a 2023 three-year term expiring 2026; the seat stood at the March 2026 meeting and no outcome is published, so the seat is left unfilled (the Fayston rule).
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2026 VT Town Clerk Contact Info' spreadsheet: lists Kim Record as Grafton Town Clerk (2026 contact directory).

Town of Grafton 2024 Town Report, OFFICERS table as of June 30, 2024 (graftonvt.org): Kim Record holds the treasurership on a 2023 three-year term expiring 2026; the seat stood in March 2026 and no outcome is published. Structure only.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2026 VT Treasurers' Contact Info' spreadsheet: lists Kim Record as Grafton's Treasurer (2026 contact directory).

Town of Grafton 2024 Town Report, OFFICERS table as of June 30, 2024 (graftonvt.org): lists auditors Arlene Carey (term to 2027), Heather Gregory (term to 2025), and Debe Plummer (term to 2026); Carey's printed term runs past the March 2026 meeting, while the other two seats stood in 2025 and 2026 with no published outcomes and are left unfilled.

Town of Grafton 2024 Town Report, OFFICERS table as of June 30, 2024 (graftonvt.org): lists listers Nancy Merrill (term to 2027), GailAnn Fisher (term to 2025), and Hardy Merrill (term to 2026); only Nancy Merrill's printed term runs past the March 2026 meeting.

Town of Grafton 2024 Town Report, OFFICERS table as of June 30, 2024 (graftonvt.org): lists Trustees of Public Funds Kimberly Record (term to 2027), GailAnn Fisher (term to 2025), and Wendy Martin (term to 2026); only Record's printed term runs past the March 2026 meeting.

sources.note: Town of Grafton 2024 Town Report, OFFICERS table as of June 30, 2024 (graftonvt.org): Grafton elects a separate three-member board of Trustees of Campbell & Woolson Funds on the same rotation as the Trustees of Public Funds: Kimberly Record (term to 2027) is minted; the seats expiring in 2025 and 2026 stood with no published outcomes and are left unfilled.

Town of Grafton 2024 Town Report, OFFICERS table as of June 30, 2024 (graftonvt.org): Grafton elects its Collector of Delinquent Taxes: Michelle Dolloph held a three-year term expiring 2026; the seat stood in March 2026 and no outcome is published. Structure only.

Town of Grafton 2024 Town Report, OFFICERS table as of June 30, 2024 (graftonvt.org): lists Kimberly Record as Town Agent on a one-year term; the office stood in 2026 and no outcome is published. Structure only.

Town of Grafton 2024 Town Report, OFFICERS table as of June 30, 2024 (graftonvt.org): lists David Culver as Moderator on a one-year term; the office stood in 2026 and no outcome is published. Structure only.

Town of Grafton 2024 Town Report, OFFICERS table as of June 30, 2024 (graftonvt.org): places the Constable under 'Appointed by Select Board' (Mike Waysville, as of June 30, 2024): the office is filled by appointment in Grafton, and the only named appointee is of 2024 vintage, too stale to mint. Structure only.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Grafton justices of the peace: Christopher Wallace, Wendy Martin, Mary Feder, David Hall, and Samuel Battaglino. The town's 2024 report prints the November 2022 slate (with David Whittall); the November 2024 listing governs.
